reviewer.summary: The application lacks critical information including full name, residence, citizenship details, and monthly deposits in GBP. Without this data, affordability and source-of-funds risk cannot be assessed, and citizenship constraints cannot be verified. However, there are no clear red flags indicating immediate disqualification.
recommended_actions: Request full name and residential address
Request proof of citizenship for all listed nationalities
Request bank statements for the last 3 months to verify monthly deposits in GBP
